card.text: Explore 143P/Kowal–Mrkos through a shape approximation based on published lightcurve models.

introduction.text: Kowal–Mrkos takes about seventeen hours to rotate. Changes in its brightness reveal a modestly elongated nucleus.

model.title: Inferred shape
model.summary: A smooth approximation of the published proportions, sized from infrared observations. The grid marks missing surface imagery. Rotation phase is illustrative.
